user.title: Connect your Pluxee account
user.description:
**Connect using your session cookie:**

1. Open [the /op/ page]({auth_url}&prompt=login) in your normal browser and log in normally. Complete any required consent screens; newsletter consent is optional.
2. After logging in, reopen [the /op/ page]({auth_url}&prompt=login).
3. Press **F12 → Application → Cookies → {cookie_origin}**. Copy all `op_session*` rows, including signature/legacy rows.
4. Paste the rows into **Session cookie** below and leave **Callback URL** empty.

data_description.session_cookie: *Alternative (optional):* Open [the Pluxee login link]({auth_url}), capture the full `.../oidc/callback?code=...` URL before the portal consumes the one-time code, and paste it into **Callback URL** below. Submit immediately (within about 60 seconds). Leave this field empty when using a session cookie.
